summary: Iteration 15 - Extended i18n Testing Complete. Tested Landing, CreatorsList, Wallet, Subscriptions, CamRoom, Messages, Feed pages across 6 languages (FR, EN, ES, DE, IT, PT). Language switcher works correctly. Most newly translated pages display correctly. Found some hardcoded French strings in Wallet page and Messages page that need wrapping with t().

issues: FAQ section shows French content from /api/site-config instead of translated fallback when config.faq exists. The fallbackFaq with t() translations is only used when config?.faq is empty.
Hardcoded French: 'Gagne 100 coins par ami·e parrainé·e' referral CTA
Hardcoded French: 'Recharger tes coins' section title
Hardcoded French: Various card/auto-reload section labels
Hardcoded French: 'Sélectionne une conversation à gauche.' in no-active-thread state
Error messages 'Lecteur non supporté' and codec error body are hardcoded in French
Footer remains in French - acceptable per iteration scope, not a regression
'CRÉATRICE VÉRIFIÉE' badge text comes from backend/component, not translated

action_items: Wallet.jsx: Wrap remaining hardcoded French strings with t() - referral CTA, pack section title, buy buttons, history title, stats labels
Messages.jsx: Wrap 'Sélectionne une conversation à gauche.' with t('messages.no_selection')
HlsPlayer.jsx: Add i18n support for error messages (cam.codec_title, cam.codec_body)
Landing.jsx: Consider always using fallbackFaq with translations instead of config.faq, or translate config.faq on backend

Footer component not in scope for this iteration (acceptable)
data-testid attributes preserved across all language switches
